manifest.settings.title: IPs-LE Settings
manifest.settings.classes.desc: Report only addresses of these classes. Empty reports every class. Runs that could not be read are reported whatever this is set to.
manifest.settings.clipboard.positions.de: Include each line and column in the copy on the clipboard. Only matters when the result is copied.
manifest.settings.copy.clipboard.desc: Copy each report to the clipboard as well as opening it
manifest.settings.kinds.desc: Report only these kinds of address. Empty reports every kind. Runs that could not be read are reported whatever this is set to.
manifest.settings.open.side-by-side.desc: Open the report in a new editor to the side
manifest.settings.safety.enabled.desc: Enable safety checks for large files
Size in bytes above which the active document gets a warning
manifest.settings.show.positions.desc: Show the line and column of each address
manifest.settings.statusbar.enabled.desc: Show the IPs-LE status bar entry for quick access
manifest.settings.telemetry.desc: Enable local-only telemetry logs to the Output panel
manifest.mcp.label: IPs-LE address extraction for agent mode
manifest.settings.workspace.excludes.des: Glob patterns of more files a folder or workspace scan skips, on top of the built-in list. Example: **/fixtures/**
manifest.settings.workspace.max-files.de: The most files one folder or workspace scan reads
The most results one folder or workspace scan reports before it stops reading
manifest.settings.workspace.patterns.des: Glob patterns of the files a folder or workspace scan reads
manifest.settings.workspace.gitignore.de: Leave out the files the project's .gitignore files leave out
manifest.settings.workspace.problems.des: Also show what a folder or workspace scan could not read in the Problems panel
manifest.settings.workspace.refusals.des: List each result a folder or workspace scan could not read, not only how many per file
manifest.settings.workspace.always-inclu: Glob patterns of files a folder or workspace scan reads even when the built-in list or .gitignore would skip them. Example: **/vendor/**
manifest.settings.workspace.binary.desc: Skip images, fonts, archives and other files that are not text
manifest.settings.workspace.default-excl: Skip dependency folders, build output, caches and lockfiles, such as node_modules, dist, .next and package-lock.json
